annual.note: All 2025 performance awards are treated as earned despite their market-capitalization conditions. June carries the annual award stock as a proxy, totaling about 0.76% of actual common shares. Options use assumed 70% volatility and a 4% risk-free rate.
annual.noteZh: 尽管存在市值条件，2025年绩效奖励均按已达标处理。六月沿用年度奖励数量作为代理，约占实际普通股股数0.76%。期权假设波动率70%、无风险利率4%。

debtCurrent.note: The June finance-lease proxy is $122.653m annual liability minus $8.528m first-half principal payments. It is assigned to the model current-debt field to obtain the correct total, not as a reported maturity classification. A $60.319m stress for unclassified new leases changes value by less than $0.18 per share.
debtCurrent.noteZh: 六月融资租赁代理值为年度1.22653亿美元负债减上半年852.8万美元本金偿还。列入模型流动债务仅为计算总额，并非申报到期分类。对未分类新租赁施加6031.9万美元压力，影响低于每股0.18美元。

limitations: The June finance-lease total is a rollforward proxy; a $60m error changes value by less than $0.18 per share. Employee awards carry the annual disclosed stock and conservatively assume all performance awards vest.
Historical years before 2023 include the disposed Apps business. Recent revenue and operating income are recast continuing operations; compare older growth and capital ratios with caution.
limitationsZh: 六月融资租赁总额采用滚动估计；6000万美元误差对每股价值影响低于0.18美元。员工奖励沿用年度披露，保守假设全部绩效奖励归属。
2023年前的历史数据包含已出售的Apps业务。近期营收和营业利润已重列为持续经营口径；比较旧年度增长和资本比率须谨慎。
businessSummary: AI advertising recommendation and performance marketing platform.
businessSummaryZh: AI广告推荐及效果营销平台。
rationale: 22% initial growth is below recent expansion; mature 65% margin is below recent continuing-operations margin near 76%, allowing more competition and employee compensation. Sales/capital 6 reflects software economics, not a perpetual zero-investment assumption.
rationaleZh: 初期22%增长低于近期增速；成熟期65%利润率低于近期持续经营约76%，为竞争及员工薪酬留余地。营收资本比6反映软件经济模式，并非永久无需投资。
